notes.title: Shepherd Knight!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Shepherd Knights![/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce [b]Shepherd Knight[/b], our upcoming adventure game where you need to protect your flock across a world brimming with ancient magic and a lot of challenges.[/p][p]Step into the boots of a fearless [b]shepherdess[/b], a member of a noble order of [b]Shepherd Knights[/b]. With your faithful dog by your side, guide and protect your sheep while unlocking forgotten paths and unraveling the mysteries of a world filled with secrets.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="8Ej7AAYZYQo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]About the game[/h1][p][/p][h3]The Path of Legacy[/h3][p]Explore a mystical world filled with forgotten ruins, ancient temples, and sacred lands. Guide your magical flock and loyal dog through breathtaking landscapes as you uncover relics and secrets of an order that saw sheep as guardians of spiritual balance.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/9f6ae75d70544995fd901b0065c86e14fcf5e3c2.gif"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h3]The Shield and the Flock[/h3][p]Defend your flock against relentless threats drawn to their magic. Wield your sword, command your companion, and face the dangers of a world where protecting your herd means preserving the legacy of the Shepherd Knights.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/2d70b48dcc3a96870020cb23a369340a85601e7b.gif"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h3]Trials of the Shepherd Knights[/h3][p]Solve ancient puzzles tied to the sacred bond between shepherd, flock, and companion. Unlock hidden paths, recover lost memories, and piece together the forgotten story of a legendary order.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/ca6cdf6cd121d60080e93c4e5b17636eb1ba3169.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Shepherd Knight DEMO[/h1][h1][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700790/Shepherd_Knight/" style="button"]Play the free demo NOW![/url] [/h1][p][/p][p]Your feedback will be truly appreciated! [/p][p]If you want to talk directly to the devs and send us any suggestions or critiques, feel free to join our community: [url="https://discord.gg/9C8B2hK"]Cadabra Discord[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]Are you ready to lead the flock? The adventure begins soon! Don’t forget to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700790/Shepherd_Knight/"]wishlist Shepherd Knight on Steam[/url]![/p]
